name: (L4 Hard Mode)
postCreateCommand: set -e; npm install -g pnpm@10.20.0 localtunnel; pnpm install; sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y chromium chromium-sandbox curl jq nano procps python3-pip; sudo curl -L https://github.com/google/osv-scanner/releases/latest/download/osv-scanner_linux_amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/osv-scanner; sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/osv-scanner; curl -L https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.18.4/gitleaks_8.18.4_linux_x64.tar.gz -o gitleaks.tar.gz; tar -xzf gitleaks.tar.gz gitleaks; sudo mv gitleaks /usr/local/bin/; rm gitleaks.tar.gz; pip install semgrep; curl -L https://github.com/grafana/k6/releases/download/v0.49.0/k6-v0.49.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz -o k6.tar.gz; tar -xzf k6.tar.gz; sudo mv k6-v0.49.0-linux-amd64/k6 /usr/local/bin/; rm -rf k6.tar.gz k6-v0.49.0-linux-amd64; pnpm exec playwright install chromium
